text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zambian press on Friday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Sweden urges the government to resume dialogue with opposition parties to facilitate the resumption of balance of payments support cut over governance concerns last year.
- A pilot and three passengers are injured after a Cessna aircraft crashlanded following an engine failure while enroute from a pleasure resort to the capital, Lusaka.
- Enraged ex-workers of the collapsed Lima Bank besiege the ministry of agriculture, under which the bank fell, demanding their terminal benefits.
- Zambia's economic growth is expected to drop this year because of poor performance in the agricultural sector.
- Energy Minister Suresh Desai says electricity trarrifs will go up over the next few years to enable the Zambia Electricity Supply Corp to recover operational costs and make a little profit.
